challenges: エルガン・ローディック (pilot 537, listed in the profile section; name settled in original_1a): jigoku_glossary.json has 'Elgan Roddick' (official) but the sources ranked above it disagree: akurasu Original Characters List 'Elgan Rhodic', fandom page 'Elgan Rhodic', akurasu Z3.R Story Summary 'Elgan Laudic'. Please settle with original_1a.
uncertain: PRECEDENCE CALLS where akurasu and fandom differ (akurasu used): ディアムド 'Diamd' (fandom/translators Diamud); ディム・サー 'Diem-Sar' (fandom Dim Sar, translators Dim Sir); パールネイル 'Pearl Nail' (fandom Pearlnail); ブラスタＥｓ 'Brasta ES' (fandom Brasta Es); ダバラーン 'Dabalan' (fandom/TV Tropes Dabaraan); ツィーネ 'Ziene' (fandom Xine). Diamd and Diem-Sar in particular look like typos of the same romanization; the orchestrator may prefer Diamud / Dim-Sar for readability.

ガルス in ジェラウド・ガルス・バンテール: wiki 'Garce' (fandom Holy Kingdom of Insaraum also says the champion's honorary surname is "Garce"). The translators proposed 'Gallus'. Kept Garce; 'Garce' is the only wiki spelling but its meaning is unverified.

Insaraum '-tail' surnames: Ribtail, Pistail, Bantail (akurasu list); fandom calls シュバル・レプテール 'Cheval Reptail' while the akurasu list says 'Cheval Repter' (original_1a). The '-tail' pattern (fandom says High Knights get the honorary surname 'Tail') suggests Reptail.

Names where the wiki disagrees with Jigoku's shipped English (wiki used): ジエー・ベイベル 'Jie Babel' (Jigoku Jie Beibel), スコート・ラボ 'Scott Lab' (Jigoku Scoat Lab), マリリン・キャット 'Marilyn Catto' (Jigoku Marilyn Catt), シオニー 'Shiony' (Jigoku Sionie; fandom uses Ziony), メール 'Mel' (fandom Mail, Z3.R summary Mer), ビーター・サービス 'Beater Services' (Jigoku and fandom: Beater Service).

テンプティ 'Tempty' (akurasu list 'Fun Tempty'); TV Tropes and the translators write Tempti. Epithet order is unresolved: akurasu 'Fun Tempty / Angry Doctrine / Sadness Sacrifice' versus TV Tropes 'Tempti of Joy / Doctrine of Anger'; original_1c uses 'Doctrine of Anger'.
ティティ 'Titi' is only romanization plus TV Tropes; no akurasu or fandom page names her.
テンシ 'Tenshi' comes from Jigoku library English; it could instead be translated ('Angel'), but the game uses the katakana as a proper name and Jigoku kept it.

バアル 'Baal': fandom and TV Tropes are mixed between Baal and Ba'al. SRW 30's official English localization reportedly renders 御使い as 'Heralds' (TV Tropes) whereas akurasu uses Angels and fandom Mitsukai/Envoys; original_1c should be told.
ナースさん 'Nurse-san': honorific policy is an open project question (docs/Z3_LESSONS.md). Jigoku library English keeps honorifics (Bonta-kun, Juzo-chan); alternative 'Miss Nurse' (translator proposal).
スヴェル: the Japanese SRW wiki says it is the Earth defense dimensional barrier 'Svell' (Norse shield Svol), not a ship. 'Svell' is a romanization only.
ジェミナイ/ジェミナイド: 'Gemini' and 'Geminid' come only from Jigoku's shipped English; no wiki spells the planet. Consistent with the confirmed 'Geminis'.

AG has no confirmed gender: Jigoku English uses 'it'; fandom lists male. Recorded as 'not applicable'. Tengoku DSC2 reveals AG is a collective of the Edel Bernals, which does not change the pronoun question.
Suzune (pilot 486): library DSC2 says the second personality is the Edel Bernal, but the JP wiki names it Ambriel (アムブリエル, original_1a). Not settled here.

Gender for Blue (pilot 523 / name ブルー) and King (pilot 525) rests on JP wiki plus context (Z3.R summary 'his right-hand man Blue'; King = Carlos Axion the elder, father of Jr.), not on a Japanese pronoun in the entry itself. Titi/Tempty/Straus/Doctrine/Gadlight/Advent/Wayne likewise rely on the JP SRW wiki (https://srw.wiki.cre.jp) infobox, a fan wiki, where the entry text has no pronoun.
Shinya (シンヤ#keyword) keyword 19 has exactly the patient text of Misako's entry 20 (copied in the game). Both patients are given here as separate people (Shinya male 少年, Misako female 少女, JP wiki).
ネオ・リアクター 'Neo Reactor', スフィアの共鳴 'Sphere Resonance', プロメテウス・エクスペリメント 'Prometheus Experiment', ブーストアップ 'Boost Up' and ナイト 'Knight' are literal renderings with no wiki source (proposed).
